div.div:
Mechanic: Enriches lightweight event with reference data.
Data Source: Queries Redis cache, SQL read-replica, or microservice.
Output: Self-contained event ready for downstream evaluation.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 389px; margin-left: 44px;

div.div:
• Latency Penalty: External synchronous query blocks stream pipeline.
• Failure Mode: Cache miss / database timeout requires circuit breaker.
• Temporal Hazard: Hydrated state might diverge from event creation time.
• Realization: Flink AsyncFunction, Kafka Streams KTable join.

div.div:
Mechanic: Strips non-essential, sensitive, or high-cardinality fields.
Purpose: Enforces GDPR / PCI-DSS boundaries before broadcast.
Output: Minimized payload reducing broker network saturation.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 389px; margin-left: 514px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;

div.div:
• Data Minimization: Removes SSNs, credit card tokens, raw passwords.
• Egress Enforcement: Applied at trust domain boundaries.
• Performance Benefit: Smaller serialization footprint speeds broker disk fsync.
• Realization: MapStruct projection, Jackson custom view serializer.

div.div:
Mechanic: Large binary payload (>1MB) persisted to Object Store.
Pointer Message: Lightweight token with URI, SHA-256 & TTL sent to broker.
Consumer Action: Hydrates blob directly from storage on demand.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 389px; margin-left: 984px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
• Broker Protection: Eliminates broker JVM heap pressure and GC pause spikes.
• Lifecycle Hazard: Orphaned blobs in S3/GCS if consumer crashes or message drops.
• Consistency Guarantee: Strong read-after-write consistency required in blob store.
• Realization: AWS S3 / Google Cloud Storage + SQS / Kafka pointer token.

div.div: 3. THE CANONICAL DATA MODEL FALLACY VS. DOMAIN BOUNDED CONTEXTS

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 448px; height: 1px; padding-top: 608px; margin-left: 29px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Canonical Data Model (Enterprise-Wide Fallacy)
• Premise: Single unified schema defining all enterprise business concepts.
• Bottleneck: Cross-departmental committee approval required for every schema change.
• Failure Mode: Massive schema bloat; lowest common denominator representation.
• Historical Fate: High failure rate in large-scale enterprise integration initiatives.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 448px; height: 1px; padding-top: 608px; margin-left: 499px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0F172A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#0F172A, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Bounded Contexts & Anti-Corruption Layers (DDD)
• Premise: Each subsystem defines autonomous local models tailored to its domain.
• Translation: Explicit Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL) translates boundary contracts.
• Resilience: Upstream schema changes are absorbed at the translation perimeter.
• Scalability: Independent team deployment velocity with zero global coupling.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 448px; height: 1px; padding-top: 608px; margin-left: 969px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000; background-color: #FFFFFF;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; background-color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Enterprise Architectural Invariants
• Payload Budgeting: Broker messages must remain under 256KB to avoid JVM GC stalls.
• Integrity Hashing: Claim check tokens must include cryptographic digests (SHA-256).
• Schema Compatibility: Wire schemas must enforce backward & forward compatibility.
